clauses.section: ## CL-D111 — Every pull request runs through the driver; the prose path is refused
requires: issues/249#issuecomment-6105220135
Option (a). A head in another repository, or a base or head commit the checkout does not hold, is refused before any run directory exists
A review-only diff that is not UTF-8 stops `BLOCKED` with its artifacts drafted
The driver prints no `PROSE_PATH:` line, the dispatch section has no step for one
the mode references are deleted in later pull requests of #249
Reinstating a hand-composed round, or reviewing a pull request from the GitHub API alone, requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: The dispatch section routes every pull request to the driver and names the refusal
requires: After the checks above, the pull request runs through the packaged driver, which sequences the round, not you.
you read no mode reference, compose no helper request, and judge no finding.

A pull request the driver refuses before any run (a head in another repository, or a base or head commit the checkout does not hold) is reported on its error output; report it and stop, and review nothing by hand (CL-D111).
4. Otherwise, when a line begins `FINISHED comment=`, report everything from that line to the end verbatim, and stop. Never run the publication script.
5. Otherwise, when a driver command prints none of these lines, report the last 30 lines of its combined output and stop; never retry or continue by hand.
